title: Dispensing timing, early fills and mail-order fills for Prescriptions & Renewals
content:
**To dispensing pharmacies — when a Prescriptions & Renewals fill may be dispensed.**

**A. Conditions for any dispensing.** A fill is dispensed only while the prescription status is active, on or before its expiration date, and while the fills the prescription still authorizes are above 0. All three are read from the system record of the same prescription before dispensing.

**B. When the next fill is due.** The next fill is due once the class's early-refill threshold of the previous fill's days' supply has elapsed. The number of days that must have elapsed is the previous fill's days' supply multiplied by the threshold percentage, divided by 100, rounded to the nearest whole day, an exact half going to the even whole day. The elapsed time is the calendar days from the date of the most recent dispensing of the prescription to the day of the new fill.

**C. Earlier fills.** An earlier fill is refused unless it is:
- a travel override — only where the class allows travel overrides and the travel-override dispensings of the prescription in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the day of the fill are below the class's yearly cap;
- a medication-synchronization short fill of no more than the class's largest synchronization short fill — only where the class allows synchronization; or
- an authorized replacement or bridge fill.

**D. Mail order and specialty dispensing.** Mail-order fills, where the class allows mail order, dispense the class's mail-order days' supply. Where the class requires a specialty pharmacy, only the designated specialty pharmacy may dispense.

**E. Each dispensing is recorded** with its date, one fill, the days' supply dispensed, the dispensing pharmacy and its basis: regular, early travel override, synchronization short fill, replacement or bridge.

**Worked figures for clause B (hypothetical previous fills).**

| Previous fill | Threshold | Share of the days' supply | Days that must have elapsed |
|---|---|---|---|
| 90 days | 75 percent | 67.5 | 68 |
| 30 days | 75 percent | 22.5 | 22 |
| 30 days | 85 percent | 25.5 | 26 |
| 30 days | 90 percent | 27 | 27 |
| 30 days | 80 percent | 24 | 24 |

**Boundary case (hypothetical).** A 30-day fill at an 80 percent threshold dispensed on 1 May: on 25 May, 24 days have elapsed and the next regular fill is due; on 24 May only 23 days have elapsed, and a fill that day is refused unless it falls under clause C.
